free_tier.stated: 'Filer.net is a worldwide cloud service available to all users for free. Registration is required to upload files.' The free plan is named 'FREE Unlimited Basic' with unlimited storage.
free_tier.notes: Premium buys speed, parallel downloads and no wait time, not more space.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the page read

retention.stated: not stated on the page read

egress.terms: Premium is sold on four features only: 'Maximum Speed', 'Parallel Downloads', 'No Wait Time', 'Download Manager'. No byte allowance appears for either tier, so the free tier is throttled and the paid tier is not, but neither is metered.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited storage on the free plan; no transfer figure published

interface_detail: Web upload with a download manager. No API or FTP is published on the page read.
tooling: Browser only as read. Filer.net is on the PrimeLeech generator list, so a leecher is the fallback.
chaining: Free unlimited storage with registration is the unusual part: it is a place to park files rather than to move them. Premium at €9.99 a month removes the throttle when a pull has to finish tonight.

limits.value: free tier is speed-limited and serialised; premium adds 'Maximum Speed' and 'Parallel Downloads' with the amount unstated

limits_note: 'Unlimited' storage is the vendor's word; no per-file cap and no retention period is printed on the page read.
binding_note: With storage unlimited and transfer unmetered, the only thing that can fail at 1 TiB a month is the speed cap on the free tier. The premium tier removes it and the page then names no further constraint.

identity_cost.detail: 'Registration is required to upload files' - a free account for the free plan, a card at checkout for premium. The signup form fields were not read.

reliability_note: Unlimited free storage with no published retention rule means files can be removed on a policy the user never sees; the page states none.
confidence_note: Prices and the four premium features read on the vendor home page today. The per-file cap, retention and the actual free speed are all unread.

evidence.proved: 'No hidden costs!', the 'FREE Unlimited Basic' plan, and the four prices: 4.99 € 2 days, 9.99 € 30 days, 19.99 € 90 days, 49.99 € 365 days

price_per_tb_month: EUR 9.99 per 30 days, no volume figure published
notes: Operated by FITSCHIGOGERL SA, Rue du 31-Décembre 36, 1207 Genève, per the page footer. The 365-day plan at €49.99 is €4.11 a month, the cheapest per month of any paid file host.

extras.vouchers: the 90-day and 365-day purchases include a 14-day and a 30-day voucher respectively
